integrity: Self-contained formulas, proof and standard-library verifier; independent external verification not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to powers-of-two length Thue-Morse substitution blocks, counts square occurrences by position and half-length; uses classical Pansiot-Brlek classification, finite 96-case local check and induction. No claim for general circular binary words. Earlier equivalent rotational extremal theorem remains possible.
title: Exact circular-square spectra and uniquely least-repetitive cuts of Thue–Morse blocks
